## Example 4 {#slide-35}

In Manoa Valley on the island of Oahu (Hawaii) the annual rainfall averages 43.6 inches with standard deviation 7.5 inches and follows an approximate normal distribution. A year is chosen at random. What is the probability that the annual rainfall is more than 56 inches?

## Technology {#slide-36}

Calculator:

1-normalcdf(43.6, 56.25,56)

![](ppt/media/image40.png "Picture 4")

## Example 4 {#slide-37}

In Manoa Valley on the island of Oahu (Hawaii) the annual rainfall averages 43.6 inches with standard deviation 7.5 inches and follows an approximate normal distribution. A year is chosen at random. What is the probability that the annual rainfall is between 32 and 56 inches?

## Technology {#slide-38}

Calculator:

normalcdf (43.6, 56.25,56) --  normalcdf (43.6, 56.25,32) 

![](ppt/media/image41.png "Picture 3")

![](ppt/media/image42.png "Picture 6")
